'''Drugindi''' was a [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] who developed the [[Blood Boiler]] bioweapon for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] hired Imperial forces to test it against the [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].
